loops.title: Evidence-Gated Optimization Loop

inputs.name: repo-port
inputs.description: Path to the exigo repo root (read + git-write access).

inputs.name: improvement-goal-port
inputs.description: One-sentence improvement goal + goal-anchored stop condition.

inputs.name: slice-map-port
inputs.description: Codebase partition; re-aimed each cycle by prior constraints (§4).

inputs.name: verified-improvements-port
inputs.description: Stare decisis — the join. Read at §1.3, appended at §14.

outputs.name: measurements-port
outputs.description: Before/after records and computed deltas. Absent from both parents.

outputs.name: refutations-port
outputs.description: Gate vetoes. Negative results are first-class output.

outputs.name: fixes-port
outputs.description: Wave F edits shipped as PR diff(s) to develop → main.

lens_scores_rationale.L1: Autonomy — inherits cd-review's day-status resume contract and adds the measure-before-mutate invariant, which is machine-checkable on resume from disk alone.
lens_scores_rationale.L2: Universality — deliberately low. The measurement catalogue is bound to Exigo's npm scripts and the ship path is GitHub/CodeRabbit-specific. Portable in structure, not in commands.
lens_scores_rationale.L3: Combinability — 8 typed inputs / 12 typed outputs, including two ports (measurements-port, refutations-port) that no other loop exposes; verified-improvements-port is both input and output, which is what makes it joinable with itself across cycles.
lens_scores_rationale.L4: Extractability — per-wave checkpoints and immutable measurements survive a mid-wave kill. Wave M is the risky span because before/after must pair; the vocabulary orders measure_before ahead of wave_f_dispatched precisely so a cold launcher can detect a broken pair.

lineage.depth_derivation: min(parent depths) − 1 = min(3, 3) − 1 = 2. The authoring loop (loop-compose, depth 2) is not a lineage parent and does not further decrement.
lineage.extraction_candidate: The Wave M measurement harness (bin/measure.py) is reusable by any loop wanting a before/after gate. If a second caller needs it, that is the itch to file.

delta_test.property: Every shipped diff carries an ADVANCE dossier with a verified citation AND a before/after measurement on a metric declared before the fix; a REFUTE vetoes an already-written, green, lens-approved diff.
delta_test.method: port-anchored capability probe; wave evidence excludes the ports region so the two evidence kinds are independent

loops.notes: Composed 2026-07-30 by agents/loop-compose/ run 2026-07-30-L001. Wave α enumerated 45 candidate port bindings from the parents' real ports: blocks; Wave β returned 16 COMPOSE / 8 CONFLICT / 21 ORTHOGONAL and bound 2 edges (audit-port→problem-statement-port forward, constraints-port→slice-map-port feedback). All 8 CONFLICTs were the resume-contract single-writer class, resolved by this loop owning one RECORD.md + one day-status.json + its own last_step vocabulary (C-001-004a). Known weak point tracked as C-J-022 (MUST_TEST): metric-gaming in Wave H. Review round 1 (CodeRabbit, PR #105): 8 valid findings fixed. The delta-test's two-evidence rule was tightened so wave evidence cannot come from the ports block (verdict survived at 8/8); the gate's ancestry conjunct is no longer skippable; resume now resolves the veto path's sub-state labels instead of silently replaying the cycle. bin/selftest.py added: 13 negative controls proving every conjunct can fail.
